names.legendary: Bouncealot the Unstoppable

lore.common: Rolls straight into the drain the moment someone kicks it gently.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into the same hedge every single game.
lore.rare: Bounces off the path at an angle no physics teacher can explain.
lore.epic: Bounced off the shed, the car and the greenhouse in one kick, and the whole street came out.
lore.legendary: Was kicked so high that it landed on the school roof and is still the school's most famous ball.

names.legendary: Zingo the Ball Who Never Stopped

lore.common: Bops the ceiling light every time it's dropped on the kitchen floor.
lore.uncommon: Always ends up under the fridge with the dust and lost peas.
lore.rare: Bounces higher every time, as if it's getting angrier.
lore.epic: Ricocheted round the kitchen so fast that everyone ducked behind the table.
lore.legendary: Was dropped from a tower and bounced back up to the top floor, where it waited politely.

names.legendary: The Ball That Answered Everything

lore.common: Always says ask again later when you need an answer right now.
lore.uncommon: Shows its answer in a cloudy bubble that takes ages to float up.
lore.rare: Gives answers so spooky that the whole sleepover goes quiet.
lore.epic: Was asked a hundred questions at the sleepover, and everyone screamed at every yes.
lore.legendary: Said yes to the question will it snow tomorrow, and the next day there was a snowman on every lawn.

names.legendary: The Marble That Won Every Game

lore.common: Rolls across the floor at night and wakes the whole house.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost under the skirting board the moment the game starts.
lore.rare: Has a swirl of colour inside that looks like a tiny galaxy.
lore.epic: Escaped the marble run and rolled down the whole school corridor.
lore.legendary: Won every playground game for a whole year, and the other marbles were too scared to play.

names.legendary: The Ball That Calmed the Office

lore.common: Gets squeezed so hard that it looks like it's pulling a face.
lore.uncommon: Has a funny face that squishes up when you squeeze it.
lore.rare: Calms down anyone who's about to shout.
lore.epic: Was squeezed by every pupil during exam week, and half of them burst.
lore.legendary: Calmed a whole office on deadline day, and nobody shouted once.

names.legendary: The Balloon That Crossed the Sea

lore.common: Floats up to the ceiling so the string is just out of reach.
lore.uncommon: Pops with a bang that makes everyone at the party scream.
lore.rare: Escapes from tiny hands and sails off over the rooftops.
lore.epic: Escaped from the party with fifty others, and the sky over the village went colourful.
lore.legendary: Floated across the whole sea and landed in another country with its party message still attached.

names.legendary: The Confetti Found a Year Later

lore.common: Ends up in every corner of the house for months.
lore.uncommon: Hides in your hair long after the party is over.
lore.rare: Clogs the vacuum cleaner so badly that it gives up.
lore.epic: Was thrown at the wedding, and the whole street sparkled for a week.
lore.legendary: Was still being found in shoes, pockets and books a whole year after the party.

names.legendary: The Bat That Hit the Ball Over the Wall

lore.common: Swings with all its might and hits nothing but air.
lore.uncommon: Gives a splinter to anyone holding it wrong.
lore.rare: Hits the ball so far that the fielders give up running.
lore.epic: Smashed a ball over the park fence and into the duck pond, and the ducks were furious.
lore.legendary: Hit a ball so far that it landed in the next town's park and won their game too.

names.legendary: The Ball That Made Every Shot

lore.common: Spins round the rim and pops back out every time.
lore.uncommon: Bounces so loudly in the hallway that the neighbours bang on the ceiling.
lore.rare: Bangs off the backboard so hard that the whole hoop shakes.
lore.epic: Was slam-dunked so hard that the playground hoop bent down like a bow.
lore.legendary: Went in from the other end of the court in the last second of the final.

names.legendary: The Book That Was Coloured Perfectly

lore.common: Gets coloured outside every line.
lore.uncommon: Has a crayon snapped in its spine from the last time.
lore.rare: Is always half finished, with every page started and none done.
lore.epic: Was coloured by the whole class on a rainy day, and every page was a different rainbow.
lore.legendary: Was coloured so perfectly by one patient child that it was framed in the school hall.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Got the Baby to Sleep

lore.common: Dribbles milk down the baby's chin every time.
lore.uncommon: Gets thrown out of the pram onto the pavement.
lore.rare: Is needed at three in the morning, every morning.
lore.epic: Was warmed up at the same time as every bottle at the toddler group, and the room was quiet at last.
lore.legendary: Got a baby to sleep through the whole night for the first time, and the parents nearly cried.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Never Leaked

lore.common: Squirts water up your nose when you squeeze it too hard.
lore.uncommon: Has its lid chewed by its owner during every match.
lore.rare: Leaks into the bottom of the school bag every single day.
lore.epic: Squirted every player on the team at half-time, and the coach got soaked too.
lore.legendary: Was carried to every match for ten years and never leaked once.

names.legendary: The Box That Had Every Colour

lore.common: Has every crayon snapped in half within a week.
lore.uncommon: Is always missing the one colour you need.
lore.rare: Leaves waxy colours on your hands and the table.
lore.epic: Was used on the bedroom wall by a toddler, and the wall became a rainbow.
lore.legendary: Had every colour in the world in it, including one nobody had a name for.

names.legendary: The Clown That Popped Out for a Century

lore.common: Pops out so suddenly that everyone drops what they're holding.
lore.uncommon: Needs winding round and round while it plays a tune.
lore.rare: Grins out of its box so widely that the cat runs away.
lore.epic: Popped out in the middle of the birthday party, and the whole room screamed then laughed.
lore.legendary: Has popped out of the same box for a hundred years and still makes grandad jump.

names.legendary: The Box That Sent Every Baby to Sleep

lore.common: Plays the same tune over and over until everyone is humming it.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound up every five minutes.
lore.rare: Plays a lullaby so gentle that the cat falls asleep too.
lore.epic: Played its lullaby at the nursery, and every baby fell asleep at once.
lore.legendary: Has sent three generations of babies to sleep with the same tune.

names.legendary: The Bucket That Built a Castle Town

lore.common: Tips its sand out before the castle is finished.
lore.uncommon: Catches crabs that pinch everyone who looks inside.
lore.rare: Makes perfect castle towers every single time.
lore.epic: Was filled with the whole beach's best shells, and the shell collectors followed it home.
lore.legendary: Built a sandcastle so big that the lifeguard climbed it to watch the sea.

names.legendary: The Pinwheel That Never Stopped Spinning

lore.common: Stops dead the moment you stop running, and refuses to spin standing still.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck when it's not facing the wind, so you have to blow on it.
lore.rare: Spins so fast that it hums.
lore.epic: Spun with a hundred others on the seaside garden, and the whole beach whirred.
lore.legendary: Spun for a whole summer on the windowsill without stopping once.

names.legendary: The Controller That Won the Final

lore.common: Gets its buttons mashed so hard that they stick.
lore.uncommon: Has a stick that drifts to the left on its own.
lore.rare: Wraps its wire round everyone's ankles.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole sleepover until sunrise, and the batteries gave up first.
lore.legendary: Won the final of a game tournament with the last button press.

names.legendary: The Console of a Thousand Journeys

lore.common: Runs out of battery just before the final level.
lore.uncommon: Has a cracked screen corner that its owner insists makes it look cooler.
lore.rare: Makes a long car journey feel like five minutes.
lore.epic: Kept the whole back seat quiet on a ten-hour drive.
lore.legendary: Survived a thousand car journeys, two drops in a puddle and one trip through the washing machine.

names.legendary: The Band That Soaked a Whole Match

lore.common: Soaks up so much sweat that it drips.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it look like a tennis star.
lore.rare: Looks so old-fashioned that everyone thinks it's a costume.
lore.epic: Soaked up the sweat of every player at the tennis club on the hottest day.
lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole five-hour tennis match without dripping once.

names.legendary: The Wig That Fooled the Whole Family

lore.common: Itches so much that its wearer scratches all evening.
lore.uncommon: Slides off sideways when its wearer nods.
lore.rare: Changes its wearer's whole personality, so every pirate wig produces a very loud pirate.
lore.epic: Was swapped between every guest at the costume party, and nobody knew who was who.
lore.legendary: Fooled a whole family into thinking grandma had a new haircut for a week.

names.legendary: The Pinata That Rained Sweets

lore.common: Refuses to break no matter how many times it's hit.
lore.uncommon: Swings away from the stick at the last second.
lore.rare: Bursts open with sweets that rain down on everyone.
lore.epic: Burst at the birthday party and showered sweets over the whole garden.
lore.legendary: Survived a hundred hits at one party before finally showering the whole street with sweets.

names.legendary: The Horse That Rocked Four Generations

lore.common: Squeaks on every rock so the whole house knows it's being ridden.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers under its rockers.
lore.rare: Rocks so fast that its rider thinks they're galloping across a field.
lore.epic: Rocked so hard in the nursery that it crossed the room and bumped the door.
lore.legendary: Has been rocked by four generations of children in the same family.

names.legendary: The Mask That Hid the Mayor

lore.common: Slips so the eye holes end up on your cheeks.
lore.uncommon: Has a face so scary that the cat hides under the bed.
lore.rare: Hides its wearer so well that nobody recognises them, not even their mum.
lore.epic: Was worn by everyone in the street parade, and the whole town felt like a festival.
lore.legendary: Hid the mayor so well at the town party that nobody knew he'd joined the conga line.

names.legendary: The Dough That Became a Zoo

lore.common: Gets ground into the carpet and never comes out.
lore.uncommon: Mixes every colour into one brownish lump.
lore.rare: Gets tasted by every toddler, who find it very salty.
lore.epic: Was made into a whole zoo by the playgroup, with a giraffe and three wonky elephants.
lore.legendary: Made a model so good that it was put in a glass case at the library.

names.legendary: The Kite That Touched the Clouds

lore.common: Gets tangled in the only tree on the whole beach.
lore.uncommon: Nosedives into the sand the moment it gets going.
lore.rare: Flies so high that it's just a speck in the sky.
lore.epic: Flew with a hundred others at the kite festival, and the sky was full of dragons.
lore.legendary: Flew so high that a passing plane's pilot waved at it.

names.legendary: The Dinosaur Who Survived the Wash

lore.common: Stabs your bare foot with its spiky tail in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Has a wobbly head that nods yes to every question it's asked.
lore.rare: Gets buried in the sandpit and dug up as a fossil.
lore.epic: Led a stampede of plastic dinosaurs across the playroom that knocked over the castle.
lore.legendary: Survived a trip through the washing machine and came out roaring louder than before.

names.legendary: The Kitchen of the Finest Plastic Cake

lore.common: Gets plastic peas served to everyone who walks past.
lore.uncommon: Has plastic food that ends up everywhere in the house.
lore.rare: Serves tea to every teddy in the room at once.
lore.epic: Opened a restaurant in the playroom, and every grown-up had to order dinner.
lore.legendary: Served a plastic cake so convincing that grandad tried to eat it.

names.legendary: The Pig That Saved for a Bicycle

lore.common: Rattles loudly every time it's picked up.
lore.uncommon: Has a cork in its tummy that nobody is allowed to pull out until the summer holidays.
lore.rare: Has no hole in the bottom, so the only way to get coins out is a lot of patient shaking.
lore.epic: Was shaken by every child at the party, and the floor was covered in coins.
lore.legendary: Saved up enough coins over five years for its owner to buy a brand-new bicycle.
